jobs.description: OPERATING ROOM ASSISTANTAmsterdam UMC’s Surgery Department is seeking passionate nurses for the role of Operating Room Assistant. This unique role allows nurses to study and work simultaneously, contributing to our Surgery Department’s high standards in both care and research. As a healthcare professional in the Netherlands, communication in Dutch is crucial. Therefore, EMTG will provide a Dutch language course for healthcare professionals. This partnership aims to equip healthcare professionals with the necessary language skills to reach an intermediate level of proficiency in Dutch. This proficiency will enable the healthcare professional to engage in daily activities and interact with clients once they arrive in the Netherlands. During this period of approximately 4 to 5 months, the healthcare professional will receive language training and learn more about Dutch culture..Your profile:·Bachelor of Nursing degree obtained in an EU/EEA country.·EU nationality.·Willing to follow a paid for educational program to become an OR nurse in the Netherlands.·Certified nurse with a minimum of 2 years of experience in an operating room and a commitment to continuous professional growth.·Desire to contribute to an excellent team, recognizing that good care is a collaborative effort.·Decisive and result-oriented with an understanding of the critical nature of every minute in the operating room.·Strong listening skills and empathy, recognizing the challenges families face in the OR.·Eagerness to learn, with a recognition that each working day is an opportunity for personal and professional development.·Availability for all shifts, contributing to our 24/7 care commitment.·English proficiency at A2/B1 level.Employment conditions·The employee will receive a fixed-term employment contract for the duration of the training program (per section 2.4.4 of the UMC CAO) in order to complete the core EPAs for Operating Room Assistant. During this period, the employee will be placed in salary scale 5 (minimum €2574 gross per month / 36 hours).·After completing the core EPAs (approximately 3 years), the employee will be placed in scale 8M (minimum €3401 gross per month / 36 hours) plus a labor market allowance and will receive a new contract to complete the specific EPAs. This stage lasts approximately 6-9 months, at which point the trainee will be 100% deployable.·22.5 vacation days.·Holiday Pay and Year-end Bonus·Free Dutch language course, accommodation, and meals at Academia Neerlandesa.·Cultural and professional experience.·Access to a European network of nurses.

The Netherlands has a very high developed healthcare system. Working in The Netherlands means that you will contribute to a healthcare system in the Top 5 of the world. Because of the changing population in The Netherlands (less young people and lots of old ones) needs the country a big number of bachelor educated nurses.The hospitals of The Netherlands are public and private. Together the hospitals wants to invest in an extra education program for highly skilled nurse positions on the departments OR, ICU, CC, and ER. Especially for the citizens of the European Union the hospitals of The Netherlands can offer education free of charge and very well paid salaries. The National Plan will start in the second half of 2023 with the education of dialyses therapists for the area of North-West of Holland. For this area we want to meet 80 experience nurses who likes to learn and work in The Netherlands.About activities of a dialysis nurse:As a dialysis nurse you treat chronic patients several times a week for a longer period of time. You often build up an intensive relationship with these patients. In addition, there is the dynamics of acute care in emergency dialysis and outside dialysis (in other departments, such as intensive care, medium care, recovery or cardiac monitoring), which is about 20% of your work. This diversity makes the work extra challenging. Your shift consists of a variety of activities including nursing, working with technical equipment, advising on nutrition and coaching in dealing with illness.As a team member you actively contribute to the quality development of our nursing care. You will have plenty of opportunities to follow professional training courses. The hospital offers you a nice place in a close-knit nursing team with about 25 colleagues. The hospital has day shifts (from 07:30 to 16:00) and evening shifts (from 12:30 to 21:00), both on weekdays and on weekends.The certified dialysis nurses work on-call services for acute dialysis after the evening shift and on weekends. We work closely together in our team and are self-organizing as much as possibleWe ask· Registered nurses in an EU-country· Working experience at the department IC, CC, Nephrology, OR or ER· Preferably you have broad experience with renal replacement therapies. Because the department is an academic department, it is important that you are enthusiastic about contributing to innovation, scientific research and training.· Learning ability for a new language (Dutch) and for a new specialism (dialyses)· Flexibility· Good level of English· Technical skillsWe offer· A permanent job at an Academic or Top-Clinical Hospital· Normal salary during the internship and education period (euro 30.700 – euro 42.100)· High salary (scale FWG50) after graduation (euro 39.000 – euro 56.7000· Living close to the Amsterdam area· Free education program for dialyses nurse· Free language course “Dutch language and culture”· Nurse registration in The Netherlands· Support for immigration and social wellbeing· Intensive introduction program· Extra payment of a month salary in the month of May· Extra payment of a month salary at the end of the year· 25 paid holidays· We also offer a holiday allowance of 8,3% of the annual income. This is the opportunity for you to start your international career with a free specialization in the area of dialysis in the best health system in the world.If you fit the profile described above, send your CV to rosa.bouwman@uwv.nl

Graduation: Building a latency impact framework for the data layer  Vanderlande Industries  Veghel  Over de afstudeeropdracht Job Description Assignment type : Graduation (internship is possible, only if you are persuing a master) Start date : February 2027 Assignmentduration : 6 months Location : Veghel Educationlevel : Bachelor / Master Desiredstudy : Data engineering, data science, software engineering, computer science, business IT & management Language : Dutch / English Description of assignment Within Vanderlande, we are currently building a new backbone for applications to reliably communicate its data with one another. It establishes common standards for how messages are structured, exchanged, understood, and versioned. Whilst reliability is imperative, we also must satisfy certain latency demands. As this new layer (the Data Layer) is being built, we increasingly want to add more features and functionalities to it. This would expectedly impact the latency of the messages flowing through the Data Layer. Currently, we don't have any insights in the latency impacts of these updates. The goal of this assignment is to first research what changes impact our latency, and by how much. Then, to set up a framework that essentially shows the (latency) costs of a new feature before implementing it. Scope increases/decreases may naturally be discussed. Department description The Central Data & Analytics department provides Data Analytics products and services (incl. governance) to the entire Vanderlande Organization (mainly internal customers). It is a federated organization, meaning that we centrally set a standard, which is adopted and implemented by decentralized franchises within the business. Next to the analytic platform, we have been building an abstraction layer for transactional data. This data layer will form the backbone of all inter-application communication within Vanderlande.
